definitions.explanation: Death that occurs abruptly and unexpectedly, without prior warning or prolonged illness. Used in both medical and general contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{同僚|どうりょう}→同僚：01023_douryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{急死|きゅうし}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{皆|みな}→皆：01810_mina⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: Everyone was shocked when our colleague died suddenly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{心臓|しんぞう}→心臓：03262_shinzou⟧⟦{発作|ほっさ}→発作：15023_hossa⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧{急死|きゅうし}だった。
examples.english: It was a sudden death from a heart attack.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い⟦スポーツ→スポーツ：04740_supootsu⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{急死|きゅうし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{相次|あいつ}ぎ、⟦{健康|けんこう}{管理|かんり}→健康管理：21662_kenkoukanri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{重要性|じゅうようせい}→重要性：04823_juuyousei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問|と}われている→問う：02299_tou⟧。
examples.english: A string of sudden deaths among young athletes has raised questions about the importance of health management.

notes:
USAGE:
Used in news reports and medical contexts. Often associated with heart-related conditions, overwork (⟦{過労死|かろうし}→過労死：14324_karoushi⟧), or hidden health problems. Can be used as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb: {急死|きゅうし}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to die suddenly).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {急死|きゅうし}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to die suddenly)
- ⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{急死|きゅうし} (a sudden, unexpected death)
- ⟦{心臓|しんぞう}→心臓：03262_shinzou⟧{急死|きゅうし} (cardiac sudden death)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{突然死|とつぜんし}→突然死：20490_totsuzenshi⟧: sudden death — very similar; slightly more emphasis on the unexpectedness
- ⟦{過労死|かろうし}→過労死：14324_karoushi⟧: death from overwork — a specific cause of sudden death, well-known internationally
